criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: Part-Whole
categories.definition: Entity X is a component, member, branch, or subsection of the larger entity Y, or Y contains X.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: Entity X is geographically situated, located, or based within the place or region Y.

categories.name: Creator-Creation
categories.definition: Entity X is the author, artist, designer, architect, or producer of the work, invention, or entity Y, or vice versa.

categories.name: Affiliation
categories.definition: Entity X is an employee, member, athlete, or official associated with an organization, team, or group Y.

categories.name: Origin-Derivation
categories.definition: Entity X is the source, basis, inspiration, or predecessor from which entity Y is derived, adapted, or evolved.

categories.name: Parent-Child
categories.definition: Entity X is the parent, child, or sibling of entity Y, indicating a direct familial lineage.

categories.name: Administrative-Territorial
categories.definition: Entity X is a political subdivision, capital, or administrative unit belonging to the governing entity Y.

categories.name: Product-Platform
categories.definition: Entity X is a product, software, game, or vehicle designed for, released on, or manufactured by entity Y.

categories.name: Event-Participant
categories.definition: Entity X is a competition, event, or award in which entity Y participated, won, or was featured.

categories.name: Hydrography-Geography
categories.definition: Entity X is a body of water flowing into, located within, or part of the water system or geographic feature Y.

categories.name: Spousal
categories.definition: Entity X is the husband, wife, or spouse of entity Y.

categories.name: Character-Work
categories.definition: Entity X is a fictional character appearing in or associated with the creative work, series, or franchise Y.

categories.name: Acquisition-Merger
categories.definition: Entity X acquired, purchased, or merged with entity Y, or Y is a subsidiary of X.

categories.name: Translation-Language
categories.definition: Entity X is a work, word, or name expressed in or translated to the language Y.

categories.name: Synonymy
categories.definition: Entity X and entity Y are equivalent terms, aliases, or different names for the same concept or entity.

categories.name: Subclass-Category
categories.definition: Entity X is a specific type, class, or instance of the broader category, rank, or classification Y.
